exclude: Withdrawn TierB, inferred labels, unknown alternatives, unreviewed sources, changed target text/order, source overlap, absent raw evidence.
grouping_scope: Existing evaluator-reviewed v2 corpus; linked/revision/crosspost/project/duplicate families remain whole. Opaque withholding metadata is not proof against unknown public memorization.
include: TierA; accepted source-backed explicit contextual comparison; target-author attribution verified; every alternative sourced; exact evidence span inside approved author span; eligible atemporal source; frozen dev group; answer-bearing whole connected group absent from the fixed original sparse fit source manifest.
population: All ordered rows in the existing active-v2 Tier-A releases, in their original order. No new item construction.
selection_bias_limit: Original target construction predates model scores. This diagnostic rule is frozen after prior development results; it retains every qualifying original TierA item without filtering by correctness. Not blinded or independent confirmation.
